name: External links
description: Marks links to other sites in posts and pages: rel="noopener noreferrer", rel="sponsored nofollow" for listed domains, optional new tab with screen-reader text, and UTM parameters for partner domains.
author: sap13ns

settings.label: Open external links in a new tab
settings.help: Adds target="_blank" and a visually hidden "(opens in a new tab)" for screen readers.

settings.label: Sponsored domains
settings.help: One domain per line (or separated by commas). Links to these domains and their subdomains get rel="sponsored nofollow".

settings.label: Domains that receive UTM parameters
settings.help: One domain per line. Subdomains are included. Existing parameters are never overwritten.

settings.label: utm_source
settings.help: Empty uses the site's host name.
